DEWALT DCD240X2-GB 54V XR FLEXVOLT paddle mixer delivers high-performance mixing for heavy materials such as plaster, mortar, and adhesives, powered by a robust 54V brushless motor for exceptional power, extended runtime, and cordless convenience. Features a dual-handle design with ergonomic, rubber-overmould grip to ensure maximum control and comfort, and 5 electronic speed settings to allow precise adjustment for optimal mixing results. All-metal gearing provides reliability and long service life, supporting smooth performance under heavy load. Supplied with paddle, 2 x high-capacity XR FLEXVOLT batteries and charger.
